nodes.label: WorkPlot
nodes.author: gievano
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI app modifying MobileGestalt/system plists on iOS 27.0 dev betas via bad_query sandbox escape; backs up MobileGestalt before each write

nodes.label: latest-release job (rolling)
nodes.rationale: Delete-then-recreate 'latest' release on every push to main; make_latest:false is mandatory because softprops defaults to true and would steal the Latest badge from stable v1.0.0

nodes.label: Static README badges
nodes.rationale: Static shields avoid broken release/status badges because the repository has no tags or releases yet

nodes.label: README humanizer rewrite
nodes.rationale: Clean human writing removes generic AI-generated fluff from project documentation

nodes.label: Rolling release 'latest'
nodes.rationale: Permanent user download link https://github.com/gievano/work-plot2/releases/download/latest/WorkPlot.ipa; accepts a brief 404 downtime window per push, acceptable for dev use case

nodes.label: Stable release v1.0.0
nodes.rationale: Holder of the GitHub Latest badge; must not be displaced by the rolling job

nodes.label: strings-file-repair skill candidate
nodes.rationale: Match the verification contract first, then style conventions - output format is defined by the checker, not by the original file's cosmetics

nodes.label: CI trigger validation before monitoring
nodes.rationale: Validate that an automated check CAN run for the target ref before waiting on its output - absence of signal is often configuration, not failure

nodes.label: windows-file-patching skill candidate
nodes.rationale: Cross-platform file mutation must treat line endings (CRLF vs LF) as part of the match contract and verify every replacement landed

nodes.label: cross-fork-pr-safety skill candidate
nodes.rationale: Public impactful operations (creating PR/issues in someone else's repo) must be target-verified explicitly before execution, especially with multiple remotes

nodes.label: gh pr create fork head qualification
nodes.rationale: Cross-repo PR requires qualified head owner:branch when branch exists only on fork; GitHub error messages often do not reveal the root cause
nodes.norm_label: gh pr create fork head qualification

nodes.label: Binary string adjacency heuristic limitation
nodes.rationale: Static artifacts generate hypotheses but rarely prove semantic mappings; never flip behavioral semantics based on layout heuristics of compiled string tables
